---
title: "About Marvel Graph Lab"
---

**Marvel Graph Lab** is a weekly blog built for *Assignment 1.8 — "Go nuts with your LLM"* in
**02805 Social Graphs and Interactions** (DTU). Each week we're handed a new snapshot of a
shared Marvel Comics character network — nodes are Wikipedia articles about Marvel characters,
edges are wiki-links between them — and we analyze it with that week's tools.

Dataset: [`week1_nodes.tsv` / `week1_edges.tsv`](https://sunelehmann.com/socialgraphs2026-web/data/)
(frozen snapshot, 2026-08-26).
